prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished concept sheet for six rank badge icons for the idle racing game Racing Tycoon. This is a concept image, not a game screenshot.
Reference images: image 1 (rank_shield.png) is a shape-language reference only: rounded broad shield with shallow pointed bottom, thick raised beveled rim, recessed center, chunky raised five-point stars and plump laurel leaves. Image 2 (05-league.png) is the approved Soft Miniature style reference only. Do not reproduce its UI or text.
Composition: landscape sheet, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, ranks 1,2,3 across the top and 4,5,6 across the bottom. Plain warm ivory background, generous clean spacing, consistent front-facing orthographic view and lighting. All six share the EXACT same underlying shield frame proportions; decorations expand progressively. Make each icon large and clearly separated. A small neutral dark gray number 1 through 6 directly beneath its corresponding badge is the only permitted text. No titles, no words, no logos, no watermark.
Style: premium Soft Miniature toy/clay 3D icons, soft rounded sculpted forms, warm friendly palette, clean silhouettes, broad satin highlights, subtle ambient contact shadows, restrained metal-inspired colors rendered as soft clay. NO old-fashioned glossy rendering, NO mirror chrome, NO sharp specular reflections, NO gritty metal, NO tiny filigree. Readability at approximately 64 pixels high is critical: bold contrast and a different overall silhouette per tier; stars must stay chunky and separated.
Exact tier progression:
1 Apprentice: warm copper/bronze, terracotta bronze recessed center, one large pale copper star, plain thick copper rim, NO wings and NO laurels, simplest compact silhouette.
2 Semi-Pro: neutral satin silver rim and mid gray center, TWO chunky silver-white stars arranged side by side, a tiny pair of silver laurel sprigs only at the lower corners (two plump leaves per side), no wings.
3 Professional: rich warm gold rim, ochre center, THREE chunky golden stars in a simple triangular arrangement (one above two), medium golden laurels with three broad leaves per side rising to the lower half of the shield, no wings.
4 National: platinum, distinct from silver: brilliant creamy platinum rim against deep desaturated blue-gray center, FOUR chunky creamy-white stars in a clear 2x2 arrangement. Tall full platinum laurels rising to the upper shoulders, short broad platinum wing tips extending horizontally beyond laurels. Bold cool-dark/light contrast, not cyan.
5 Continental: ice-blue crystalline diamond shield, saturated turquoise-blue recessed center and pale cyan rim, FIVE chunky pale icy stars (one above, two middle, two below), a few large softly beveled crystal facets in the rim, medium cyan crystal wings extending diagonally outward, integrated full icy laurels. Opaque stylized clay crystal, no glass transparency, no busy sparkles. Strong unmistakably BLUE silhouette.
6 World: legendary radiant warm gold shield with deep amber center, SIX chunky gold-white stars in three clear pairs, massive wide swept-up gold wings with just 3-4 bold feather lobes per side, large gold laurels, prominent simple three-point golden crown above the shield, restrained solid soft sunburst/halo behind the crown. Rich yellow gold distinct from bronze; regal and the most expansive silhouette. Halo subtle enough to retain crisp edges.
Maintain coherent family, shared rim thickness and sculpting language. Prioritize big color blocks, star count, progressive silhouette and tier recognition over microdetail. Entire badges fully in frame with no overlaps.

v2.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one concept sheet of six rank icons for the idle racing game Racing Tycoon.
Create a NEW cleaner v2 design, not game UI.
Input images: rank_shield.png is a reference for the broad rounded shield silhouette only; 05-league.png is a reference for the approved Soft Miniature toy/clay rendering only. Do not copy its UI, lettering, or busy decoration.
Composition: landscape 3:2 sheet, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, rank 1,2,3 left to right on top, rank 4,5,6 left to right on bottom. Uniform plain light warm ivory background, generous empty spacing and margins. Consistent front-facing orthographic view, shared underlying shield proportions, each badge fully visible. A small neutral gray numeral directly beneath each icon: top row "1" "2" "3"; bottom row "4" "5" "6". These six small numerals are the ONLY text. No league names, titles, words, logos, watermarks.
MOST IMPORTANT: every single shield has EXACTLY ONE LARGE CENTRAL FIVE-POINT STAR, with empty uncluttered space around it. One star per badge regardless of rank. NEVER multiple stars, NO stars on rims or wings, NO star clusters, NO star-count progression. Rank recognition comes from material/color, rim construction, and silhouette.
Style/medium: premium Soft Miniature, chunky softly rounded toy/clay objects, warm friendly colors, clean edges, simple large forms, soft satin finish, gentle broad highlights and subtle contact shadows. Restrained metal-inspired clay colors, not realistic polished metal. Designed to read clearly at about 64 pixels tall.
Exact tiers:
1 Apprentice / Tap su: plain compact warm copper-bronze shield, muted terracotta center, one large pale bronze star, simple smooth single rim. NO side ornaments, NO wings, NO crown, NO top gem.
2 Semi-pro / Ban chuyen: equally simple neutral silver shield, charcoal-gray recessed center, one large silver-white star. A modest raised silver rim/lip only. NO side ornaments, NO wings, NO crown, NO top gem. Clearly SILVER rather than blue.
3 Professional / Chuyen nghiep: rich warm gold shield with ochre center and one large pale gold star. Broad stepped rounded gold rim, two tiny solid gold side tabs integrated into the shoulders, no feathers yet. NO crown or gem.
4 National / Quoc gia: pale platinum rim with a distinct mint-turquoise recessed face, one large creamy platinum star. Clean double raised rim and one small chunky rounded wing on each side, just two broad lobes per wing. NO crown, NO top gem. Clear turquoise/mint color identity.
5 Continental / Luc dia: diamond/crystal BLUE shield, deep cobalt-blue center, one large icy blue-white star, pale ice-blue rim with only a few large soft crystal facets. Medium broad ice-blue side wings, only two or three large lobes each. ONE simple blue diamond-shaped gemstone attached at the top apex of the shield. NO crown. Strong blue identity distinct from mint rank 4.
6 World / The gioi: legendary warm GOLD shield and wide swept-up golden wings, deep royal PURPLE recessed center with restrained warm crimson accent at the inner lower rim, ONE large pale gold central star. Gold rim bold and sculpted but clean. Each large wing has only three broad rounded lobes. A SMALL SIMPLE three-point gold crown attached above the shield, much smaller than its face. Most expansive silhouette, still uncluttered. Purple must be visible as a large clean color block. No halo, rays, sparkles, gems or extra symbols.
Constraints: coherent icon family with progressive silhouette; large stars at similar relative scale in all badges; broad color blocks; low detail count; keep ranks 1 and 2 very simple. No laurels, wreaths, leaves, filigree, engraving, checkerboards, floating particles, glitter, starbursts, sharp shiny speculars, glass transparency, mirror chrome, photoreal metal, old glossy game-art rendering. Never use the number of stars to communicate rank.
